shared_elements: low-relief carved figural imagery on a stone slab/monolith
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow carved imagery involving human-like figures, arms and a disc-like motif, but the resemblance stops at that generic level. A shows a single massive frontal anthropomorphic body with a face, arms crossed over the torso, pendant/disc ornaments and encircling belt-like bands, whereas B shows a row of several slender profile figures facing one another with raised arms, in an offering-like grouping beneath a band of small signs — a quite different compositional scheme and figural convention.
